change: Legitimate CEI: fund and return reserve/cumulative bookkeeping now precedes token pulls; all exact balance deltas, runtime checks and mutation guard remain. Two medium and two low post-call bookkeeping observations removed; four high IDs unchanged.

preconditions: Exact declared reward token/runtime/supply/decimals must actually be the separately admitted fixed-supply Token V2; constructor pins alone do not establish RMT identity.
Every outgoing token path enters the campaign mutation guard; actual Token V2 has no callback/tax/proxy/mint entry.
A different or malicious admitted asset/composition requires a new assessment; read-only provisional state is not canonical settlement.
rows.remainingUncertainty: Static warning remains; local counterfactual mocks and internal reasoning do not prove all dependencies/compositions safe or constitute independent audit.
rows.remediation: Preserve exact deltas, mutation guard and bytecode admission. Do not remove before/after reads or hide them behind analysis exclusions.

Reentrancy in RMTReclaimCampaignV1._pull(address,uint256) (reclaim/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV1.sol#97-101):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- _call(abi.encodeCall(IReclaimERC20.transferFrom,(from,address(this),amount))) (reclaim/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV1.sol#99)
		- (ok,result) = rewardToken.call(data) (reclaim/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV1.sol#108)
	Balance read before the call:
	- b = IReclaimERC20(rewardToken).balanceOf(from) (reclaim/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV1.sol#98)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- IReclaimERC20(rewardToken).balanceOf(address(this)) != a + amount || IReclaimERC20(rewardToken).balanceOf(from) + amount != b (reclaim/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV1.sol#100)
		- stale variable `b`

custody.return: Original claimant repays exact original reward; original NFTs return only to that claimant; consumed eligibility and lifetime caps never reset.
custody.unsupportedForcedAssets: Unattributed unsafe ERC721/foreign token/forced native transfers may be unrecoverable.
custody.foreignNftAuthorityRisk: Runtime/ERC165 do not detect proxies, issuer seizure/burn/blacklist or lying interfaces. Finite collection/token-ID admission and separate policy review are required.

economics.liability: No NFT accepted without atomic reward payment; outstandingLiability=0, no IOU.
economics.conservation: funded+repaid+unsolicited = reserve+paid+recovered; actual reward balance >= accounted reserve
